form.name: Name
form.errOrg: Please add a company or project name.
form.errEmail: Please add an email we can reply to.
form.errScope: Please describe the task in a sentence or two.
form.idle: Goes straight to the team. A person reads every message.
form.privacy: We use these details only to reply to you.
form.errFast: That was quick. Check the form and press Send again.
form.errSend: The message did not go through. Try again, or send it from your email app to {{email}}.
form.errLimited: Too many messages from this connection. Try again in a few minutes, or write to {{email}}.
form.errHuman: We could not confirm the message came from a person. Try again, or write to {{email}}.

receipt.sentBody: {{reply}}, a person from the team will write back to {{email}}.

autoreply.subject: We have your message — MIW Labs
autoreply.body:
Hello,

This is an automatic confirmation: your message has reached the MIW Labs team. A person from the team will reply within one working day.

If you would like to add something, reply to this email.

MIW Labs
